relationships.subject: oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot revealed an increase in TLR4 expression in the DRG of oxaliplatin at days 1 and 7 after oxaliplatin treatment.

relationships.subject: LPS-RS
relationships.evidence_quote: Cotreatment of rats with the TLR4 antagonist lipopolysaccharide derived from Rhodobacter sphaeroides ultrapure or with the nonspecific immunosuppressive minocycline with oxaliplatin resulted in significantly attenuated hyperalgesia on day 7 and 14

relationships.subject: LPS-RS
relationships.evidence_quote: These increases were blocked by cotreatment with either lipopolysaccharide derived from Rhodobacter sphaeroides or minocycline.

key_findings: Oxaliplatin increases TLR4, MyD88 and TRIF in DRG neurons; TLR4 antagonism attenuates hyperalgesia in both sexes.
